meta.query: Which countries have the most recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes?
meta.interpretation: Count recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes per country, showing which countries have the most.
assumptions: all 868 matching trials were fetched; values are exact.
warnings: Showing the 20 largest of 83 country values.

plan.interpretation: Count recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes per country, showing which countries have the most.

verification.method: Every row, node, and edge was re-derived from the fetched trial records by a second pass that shares only the field definitions with the aggregation code; every citation was checked for membership in its datum and every cited field value against the record. Registry counts cannot be re-derived locally and are checked for internal consistency instead.

checks.name: citations_match_records
checks.detail: 60 citations point at fetched records and quote values present in them

checks.name: partition_sum
checks.detail: rows overlap (a trial can sit in several rows), so values are not summed
